about.full: Suveoo (from Estonian suveöö, 'summer night') is a trusted execution layer for banking agents: the LLM may only propose operations, which are compiled into a typed BankAction IR and must pass the five verifiers of the Suveoo Verification Runtime (policy tiering, consent binding, provenance taint tracking, financial invariants, replay idempotency) before execution. Banks may swap the underlying model; authorization, compliance and audit rules do not change with it.
about.intro: Suveoo is an Agentic Banking Control Plane: it strictly separates probabilistic AI intelligence from deterministic financial authority. AI can only propose; proposals must pass five deterministic verifiers before touching funds.

legal.cookieBody: Necessary cookies: language (suveoo_lang), cookie choice (suveoo_cookie_consent). Analytics: Google Analytics (G-KLK499CDQF), off by default, enabled only via Cookie Preferences.
legal.p3b: Conversations are proxied server-side (Worker) to the model provider; authorization fields come only from your explicit input, and external text (e.g. merchant notes) is marked untrusted and can never authorize anything.
legal.p4b: JWT sessions (1 hour), PBKDF2 password hashing (100,000 rounds), hashed verification codes, short-lived Consent Grant binding (120 seconds).
legal.p5b: Export (monthly PDF) or delete your account data at any time.
legal.privacyBody: We only process information you voluntarily submit for the demo (e.g., email, nickname). Data is stored on Cloudflare (KV / Durable Objects / R2). AI chats are proxied server-side to the model provider and never include your password or full card number. Deleting your account removes all data.
